claim.claim-text: 1. A time-division duplex, TDD, controller for an in-vehicle network, the TDD controller configured to adapt a duration of time a transmitter transmits a transmit signal during a TDD frame over a single pair of cables to a remote Ethernet transceiver.
2. The TDD controller of claim 1, configured to adapt the duration based on an amount of data buffered by a transmit buffer.
3. The TDD controller of any preceding claim, configured to control when the transmitter transmits the transmit signal to the remote Ethernet transceiver.
4. The TDD controller of any preceding claim, configured to provide a control signal to components of a physical layer device.
5. The TDD controller of claim 4, configured to provide the control signal to indicate when the physical layer device is to transmit.

6. The TDD controller of claim 4, configured to provide the control signal to components of the physical layer device to prevent adapting a filter used by a receiver during times when the physical layer device is to transmit.
7. The TDD controller of any preceding claim, configured to adapt a length of time of the TDD frame.
8. The TDD controller of any preceding claim, configured to control a receiver to stop adaptation of an equalizer or cross-talk canceler.

9. The TDD controller of any preceding claim, configured to control when the transmitter starts or stops transmitting the transmit signal during the TDD frame over the single pair of cables to the remote Ethernet transceiver in the in-vehicle network.
10. A system, comprising: a physical layer device comprising the TDD controller of any preceding claim.
11. The system of claim 10, further comprising: a media access control, MAC, controller.

12. The system of claim 10 or 11, wherein the components of the physical layer device to which the control signal is provided comprise a transmit buffer and/or a receive buffer and/or a transmitter and/or a receiver and/or an analog-to-digital converter and/or a digital-to-analog converter and/or an amplifier.
13. The system of any of claims 10 to 12, wherein the physical layer device comprises:
14. A vehicle, comprising the TDD controller of any preceding claim 1 - 9, or the system of any preceding claim 10-13.
15. An Ethernet transceiver in an in-vehicle network, comprising the TDD controller of any preceding claim 1 - 9, or the system of any preceding claim 10-13.
